wikiclone-import-missing: Error shown when the requested title does not exist upstream. $1 is the prefixed title.
wikiclone-import-failed: Error shown when an import fails. $1 is the underlying error message.
wikiclone-save-failed: Error when MediaWiki refuses to save an imported page. $1 is the prefixed title, $2 the underlying reason.
wikiclone-branch-name: Column heading and form label for a branch's name.
wikiclone-branch-forkedfrom: Column heading and form label for the branch a branch was forked from.
wikiclone-branch-create: Heading and button label for the form that creates a branch.
wikiclone-branch-exists: Error shown when the requested branch name is taken. $1 is the name.
wikiclone-branch-badname: Error shown when a branch name contains characters that are not allowed.
wikiclone-branch-menu: Label of the branch menu in the page tabs. $1 is the branch currently being read.
wikiclone-branch-viewing: Notice shown while reading a branch other than live. $1 is the branch name.
